mapper.select: SELECT CASE WHEN COUNT(q.id) = COUNT(ih.question_id) THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END FROM game_sessions gs INNER JOIN suspects s ON s.case_id = gs.case_id INNER JOIN questions q ON q.suspect_id = s.id LEFT JOIN interrogation_history ih ON ih.question_id = q.id AND ih.session_id = gs.id WHERE gs.id = #{sessionId}

SELECT s.id AS suspectId, s.name, s.role_name AS roleName, s.initial_statement AS initialStatement, q.id AS questionId, q.question_text AS questionText, st.answer_text AS answerText FROM game_sessions gs INNER JOIN suspects s ON s.case_id = gs.case_id INNER JOIN questions q ON q.suspect_id = s.id INNER JOIN statements st ON st.question_id = q.id WHERE gs.id = #{sessionId} ORDER BY s.display_order, q.display_order
